reply_text:
I told Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message that the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is **84 seats**.

On Oct 14 Tobias posted 382 seats in #central-team. Later that day he corrected it in #central-random to 84 seats, saying he'd read the wrong line. Hollis is a member of both channels, so I could share the correction there. My reply explained that 382 was replaced and that 84 is the number for the account sheet.
